Fun with new cards during a day of sentinels with friends.

Parse is crazy strong.  Although you have to be careful, like don't put parse right before the environment turn and then blindly play the bottom card of Fanatic's deck.  That can go bad. . . really bad.  Seriously, we played End of Days when we were all set up and Infinitor had no manifestations out.  Fugue State Parse + FV Legacy dominate any match without destruction.  Infinitor became a joke after 3 rounds, you know, aside from when we destroyed everything.

Kill the Spirit and Plague Rat is fun.  Everyone else wan't happy about the Afflicted attacks, but Fanatic loved it.

Completionist Guise loves Fanatic, Redeem and Resolute are great powers for him, as is Barbarian - Exorcism.  Sadly we haven't incapped Completionist Guise yet, so his amazing incaps haven't gotten used.

Freedom V match was ridiculous.  Legacy was set up increadibly fast thanks to overwatch and Tactical Uplink.  Wraith shut down Dawn and fed Tachyon cards.  Poor Citizens, they were no match.

 

But the best yet involved a card without a deck, when Dark Watch and Kaargra Warfang were put on trial before the Celestial Tribunal.

Mr. Fixer with Jackhandle and Bloody Knuckles using Representative of Earth Blood Mage Lifeline's innate power was pretty impressive, and ended that fight really fast.
